common questions

Aura works with all major model providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. You can also bring your own fine-tuned models.
We charge based on inference volume, not seats. Free tier includes 10k requests/month. Pay-as-you-go starts at $0.001 per request after that.
Yes. Aura Cloud is our managed offering, but the core orchestration engine is open-source. Deploy it in your own VPC with our Helm charts.

LangChain is a framework for building LLM applications. Aura is infrastructure — it handles the operational side: routing, caching, rate limiting, monitoring, and failover. They complement each other well; many teams use LangChain on top of Aura.

Yes. Enterprise plans include dedicated support, custom SLAs, SSO/SAML, audit logs, and priority access to new features. Contact us for details.
